method: built-in image_gen cutout component sheets; deterministic layered joint animation
scope: four-facing soldier/walker walk review only; no gameplay replacement

candidates.prompt:
Create a production-ready transparent CUTOUT ANIMATION LAYER SHEET for the illustrated RTS SOLDIER in the references. This is NOT a walk sprite sheet. It is a set of detached illustrated body parts that will be rigged and moved smoothly, so every part needs complete painted surfaces and generous joint overlap. Match the attractive crisp shaded brushwork style, muted steel-blue uniform and cap, warm face and hands, olive backpack, black two-handed low-ready rifle, orange sleeve badge and dark boots. Soft fixed overhead-left illumination, broad readable shaded planes, sharp edges, no blur or noisy texture.

LAYOUT: exactly THREE columns and FOUR rows, 12 isolated objects, portrait 1024x1536 or larger. Large true transparent gutters and outer margins, no labels, grid or background. Four rows are four actual elevated orthographic views: ROW1 SE front-right quarter (Image1); ROW2 E right profile (Image2); ROW3 NE rear-right quarter (Image3, but lower the rifle into the same low-ready grip); ROW4 N directly from behind (Image4). Same character proportions and color family in all views. Each row uses its respective reference to control facing, NOT a frontal view repeated throughout.

COLUMN1 in every row: ONE UPPER-BODY ASSEMBLY: head, neck, complete torso, both complete arms and hands, rifle, backpack, belt and full pelvis. End the trousers at short rounded hip sockets just below the crotch; DO NOT include legs or boots. Arms, fingers, rifle and backpack must be fully intact; on the rear view include the visible rifle at the side. Hip sockets should overlap the detached thigh tops when assembled, not a sharp cut leaving a hole.
COLUMN2: ONE COMPLETE NEAR LEG detached, from a rounded full hip/thigh through knee and shin to the entire boot. Calm neutral slightly bent leg, thigh generally downward, ankle under hip. Complete hidden inner surfaces at the hip and knee, not a scrap cut from the image. Use the visible screen-near leg for that facing. Steel-blue cloth and dark boot. No torso, hand, arm, second leg, labels or shadows.
COLUMN3: ONE COMPLETE FAR LEG detached with identical hip-to-sole anatomical length and matching knee height/width, in the same relaxed neutral orientation and view as column2. Complete surfaces, rounded overlapping hip top, full boot. Subtly darker far-facing shading, but same blue hue/material as near leg. For N use left leg in column2 and right leg in column3.

SCALE: all parts across each row share ONE anatomical scale; assembled height about 300px. Upper assembly from helmet to hip roughly 185px high. Each detached hip-to-sole leg roughly 125px high, both legs equal length. Center each object in its cell, leave about 30% empty margin. Both leg soles level, no step pose or lifted knee. Legs are NOT smaller decorative thumbnails. Exact TWO detached legs per row, not pairs of legs. Do not show any complete assembled character or animation frames. True clean alpha, no checkerboard, contact/cast shadows, glow or studio matte. Preserve high-quality illustrated anatomy and readable shaded materials.

Create a production-ready transparent CUTOUT ANIMATION LAYER SHEET for the illustrated RTS WALKER ZOMBIE in the four references. This is NOT an animation-frame sheet. Detached body parts will be rigged and moved smoothly. Match crisp high-quality shaded brushwork: bald light-grey skin, haggard face, torn dark GREY shirt, lighter GREY trousers and dark GREY boots. Absolutely no colorful ordinary-zombie clothing, beige trousers, blood or gore. Fixed soft overhead-left light, readable shaded forms and sharp edges. Preserve the character's hunched posture and long slack hands, not a muscular monster.

LAYOUT exactly THREE columns FOUR rows, twelve isolated objects, portrait 1024x1536 or larger with true transparent background and generous empty gutters. ROW1 SE front-right quarter as Image1; ROW2 E right profile as Image2; ROW3 NE rear-right quarter as Image3; ROW4 N direct-back as Image4. Same elevated orthographic camera, grey palette, shading and anatomical scale throughout. Different real facings, no repeated frontal heads.

COLUMN1 each row is ONE UPPER-BODY ASSEMBLY: complete head, neck, torso, both full arms including EVERY finger and hand, torn shirt, and full trouser pelvis ending at short rounded hip sockets just below the crotch. No legs or boots in column1. Hands must remain complete even if extending below the hip socket; detached legs will sit behind them. Fully paint the hip socket surfaces; no amputated ragged holes or missing sides.
COLUMN2 each row is ONE COMPLETE NEAR LEG from rounded hip/thigh to knee, shin and full boot. Lighter-grey torn trousers and dark boot. Calm, nearly upright, slightly bent neutral leg, ankle under hip. Complete hidden inner thigh and knee surfaces needed for overlapping animation. NOT a pair of legs. No hand, arm, pelvis or torso attached.
COLUMN3 each row is ONE COMPLETE FAR LEG, matching hip-to-sole length, knee height, width, pale-grey fabric and dark boot of column2. Slightly darker far-side shaded planes, same neutral hue. Same facing. Entire rounded hip top, lower leg and boot intact. For N use left and right legs. Do not paint entire characters anywhere.

One anatomical scale per row: upper assembly around 180px from head to hip and each detached hip-to-sole leg around 125px, assembled about 300px tall. Both legs same length and level soles; no lifted step, kick or stride pose. Each object centered with generous margins; never touch another object or the image edge. Sharp richly sculpted illustrated surfaces that remain legible at tiny RTS game size. No labels, numbers, guide dots, grid, stage, background panel, cast/contact shadows, halos, glow, checkerboard or studio matte; empty regions true alpha.

rejected: Initial manual cutouts from flattened full-character poses left hip gaps, static boot remnants and clipped hands. Not installed as review artwork.
